comparison.objective: Sort rubbish into bins according to a material rule; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Classification and pick-and-place across bins versus recessed-tool insertion, counterholding, fine rotation, and force control.
comparison.success_condition: Every item must enter its rule-defined bin; candidate requires bounded dynamic response and a locked, drift-resistant setting.
comparison.reason: Classification-based sorting does not overlap with mechanical commissioning.
